vocabulary.meaning_en: say that you are not happy with something
vocabulary.example: I'd like to complain about the room.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a statement that something is wrong or not good enough
vocabulary.example: We received a complaint from a customer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sad because something was not as good as you hoped
vocabulary.example: I'm very disappointed with your service.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the help and work a business gives its customers
vocabulary.example: The service at this hotel is excellent.
The standard of service is not good enough.
This report is not good enough. Please check it again.

vocabulary.meaning_en: what you believe something will be like
vocabulary.example: The room did not meet my expectations.

vocabulary.meaning_en: be as good as people hoped
vocabulary.example: The new software met all our expectations.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a subject or problem you need to deal with
vocabulary.example: I would like this matter resolved quickly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: find an answer to a problem (formal)
vocabulary.example: We will resolve the problem today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: say that something planned will not happen
vocabulary.example: I would like to cancel my reservation.
I would like a full refund.

vocabulary.meaning_en: things that you need or ask for
vocabulary.example: The room did not meet our requirements.

vocabulary.meaning_en: say firmly that something must happen
vocabulary.example: He insists on a twin room.
Please sort out this mess quickly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: stay calm in a difficult situation
vocabulary.example: Keep your cool and explain the problem politely.

vocabulary.meaning_en: always telling other people what to do
vocabulary.example: My new manager is a bit bossy.
She was flustered before the big meeting.
He wants freshly squeezed orange juice.

fine_lines.title: complain vs complaint
fine_lines.explanation_ar: complain فعل (يشتكي)، وcomplaint اسم (شكوى). نقول make a complaint أو complain about.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Complain is a verb. Complaint is a noun. Say: complain about something / make a complaint.

examples.sentence: I want to complain about the noise.
She made a complaint to the manager.

fine_lines.title: disappointed vs disappointing
fine_lines.explanation_ar: disappointed تصف شعور الشخص، وdisappointing تصف الشيء الذي يسبب خيبة الأمل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Disappointed describes how a person feels. Disappointing describes the thing that causes the feeling.

expressions.phrase: I'm very disappointed with your service.
expressions.meaning_ar: أنا خائب الأمل جدًّا من خدمتكم.
expressions.meaning_en: I am not happy with how you served me.
expressions.example: I waited an hour for help. I'm very disappointed with your service.

expressions.phrase: The standard of service is not good enough.
expressions.meaning_ar: مستوى الخدمة ليس جيدًا بما يكفي.
expressions.meaning_en: The quality of the service is too low.
expressions.example: The standard of service is not good enough for a five-star hotel.

expressions.phrase: The room I booked did not meet my expectations.
expressions.meaning_ar: الغرفة التي حجزتها لم ترقَ إلى توقّعاتي.
expressions.meaning_en: The room was worse than I expected.
expressions.example: I'm sorry, but the room I booked did not meet my expectations.

expressions.phrase: I would like this matter resolved as quickly as possible.
expressions.meaning_ar: أودّ أن تُحلّ هذه المسألة بأسرع ما يمكن.
expressions.example: Please call me back. I would like this matter resolved as quickly as possible.

expressions.phrase: I would like to cancel my reservation and get a full refund.
expressions.meaning_ar: أودّ إلغاء حجزي واسترداد المبلغ كاملًا.
expressions.meaning_en: Stop the booking and give me all my money back.
expressions.example: If you can't help, I would like to cancel my reservation and get a full refund.

expressions.phrase: I'd like to speak to your manager, please.
expressions.meaning_ar: أودّ التحدث إلى مديرك من فضلك.
expressions.meaning_en: Ask to talk to a more senior person.
expressions.example: Thank you, but I'd like to speak to your manager, please.

expressions.phrase: Don't panic, it's all taken care of.
expressions.meaning_ar: لا تقلق، كل شيء تم ترتيبه.
expressions.example: Don't panic, it's all taken care of. The room is ready.

grammar.title: Complaining politely and formally
grammar.explanation_ar: عند الشكوى نبقى مهذبين ونستخدم لغة رسمية: I'm disappointed with... / ... is not good enough / ... did not meet my expectations بدلًا من كلمات غاضبة مثل terrible أو awful.
grammar.explanation_en: When you complain, stay polite and formal. Use: I'm disappointed with..., ... is not good enough, ... did not meet my expectations, instead of angry words like terrible.
examples: The quality is not good enough.
The product did not meet our expectations.

grammar.title: would like + object + past participle
grammar.explanation_ar: I would like this matter resolved تعني أريد أن تُحلّ هذه المسألة (من قِبَل شخص آخر). التركيب: would like + المفعول + التصريف الثالث للفعل.
grammar.explanation_en: I would like this matter resolved = I want someone to resolve it. Pattern: would like + object + past participle.
examples: I would like this matter resolved quickly.
I would like the room cleaned, please.
We would like the order delivered by Friday.

questions.question: Which sentence is a polite complaint?
choices: I'm very disappointed with your service.
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير المهذب الرسمي هو I'm very disappointed with your service.
questions.explanation_en: The polite, formal phrase is I'm very disappointed with your service.

questions.question: The room did not ___ my expectations.
questions.explanation_ar: نقول meet expectations، وبعد did not نستخدم الفعل المجرد.
questions.explanation_en: We say meet expectations; after did not use the base verb.

questions.question: "Refund" means...
questions.explanation_en: A refund is money given back.

questions.question: I would like this matter ___ as quickly as possible.
questions.explanation_ar: التركيب would like + مفعول + تصريف ثالث: resolved.
questions.explanation_en: Pattern: would like + object + past participle: resolved.

questions.question: The standard of service is not good ___.
questions.explanation_ar: not good enough تعني ليس جيدًا بما يكفي.
questions.explanation_en: Not good enough = below the level you expect.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: "She made a ___ to the manager."
questions.explanation_en: After 'a' we need the noun complaint.

questions.question: The service was ___. (describes the service)
questions.explanation_ar: disappointing تصف الشيء المسبب لخيبة الأمل.

questions.question: "Keep your cool" means...
questions.explanation_ar: keep your cool تعني ابقَ هادئًا.

questions.question: What kind of room did Mr Socrates want?
I would like to ___ my reservation.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد would like to نستخدم الفعل المجرد.
questions.explanation_en: After would like to use the base verb.
